title: Floral carpet (dark blue ground)
notes: Floral carpet (dark blue ground). 18th century, Late Safavid or Khanates Period, Azerbaijan. Türk ve İslam Eserleri Museum , Istanbul. Acquired 1914. inv. no 741 (3055) from Cerablus (Kargamish, Gaziantep, Turkey). 310 x 645 cm. published Serare Yetkin's "Early Caucasian carpets in Turkey", plate 57. Catalogued as a copy of a"vase" carpet from Azerbaijan.
